name: @mmo-engine/dungeon
description: Procedural dungeon layouts, baked offline: scatter, separate, Delaunay, MST + loops, room roles, carve, decorate. Deterministic per seed; a port of Dungeon Forge (MIT).

scripts.build: node ../../scripts/dep-build.mjs @mmo-engine/wfc && node ../../scripts/dep-build.mjs @mmo-engine/placement && node ../../scripts/dep-build.mjs @mmo-engine/species && node ../../scripts/dep-build.mjs @mmo-engine/picg && node ../../scripts/dep-build.mjs @mmo-engine/synthesis && tsc -p tsconfig.json
